consequence.statement: No operational consequence: existing clusters keep working unchanged; Kafka brokers whose listener authentication is `type: custom` merely gain the ability to configure `ssl.principal.mapping.rules`.
consequence.remediation: No action required; operators who need custom principal mapping rules with `type: custom` authentication can now set them.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 adds the ability to configure the Kafka broker configuration key `ssl.principal.mapping.rules` in Kafka brokers whose listener authentication is `type: custom` (the same entry also mentions allowing custom trusted CAs, which is not separately asserted here).
